claims.statement: claudebar's test strategy is layered: Rust unit tests in each module, CLI integration tests over dispatch, deterministic insta golden snapshots over fixtures/, bats suites for install.sh and statusline-command.sh, and CI jobs (rust.yml, security.yml, verify-install.yml, benchmark.yml) that run the whole stack on push/PR.

Every Rust module carries a #[cfg(test)] mod tests block exercising its pure-logic surface, including parsers in src/model/, segment formatters in src/segment/, the render pipeline in src/render/, theme/style tables, sanitization in src/sanitize.rs, and config/feature logic.

The TUI drawing shell (src/tui/mod.rs, src/tui/ui.rs, src/tui/preview.rs) intentionally sits at 0% coverage because it depends on ratatui terminal primitives needing a TestBackend harness; in contrast, src/tui/app.rs is kept free of ratatui draw calls and now carries real #[cfg(test)] tests (save_clears_dirty, reset_restores_defaults_and_cursors, toggle/reorder/threshold-cycle) that run under --all-features.

tests/cli_main_dispatch.rs spawns the real claudebar binary via env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_claudebar") and asserts exit codes and stdout/stderr for each subcommand (render, init, list/--list-segments, sync, doctor, completions, help, version, config); tests/cli_smoke.rs pipes fixture data into render and asserts exit-0 plus non-empty output.

A pre-existing clap debug-assertion bug (conflicting --segments long flag) was fixed in src/cli.rs by renaming the List-subcommand flag to --list-segments so the dispatch tests run cleanly with exit code 0 in debug builds.

render_golden.rs golden_lines renders every fixtures/*.json with the default config, a fixed clock (FIXED_NOW=1_899_990_000, just before far-future resets_at epochs so countdowns are present) and a fixed $HOME=/home/me, then replaces ESC bytes with \e and insta snapshots each full line for deterministic output.

The golden_matrix test renders fixtures/typical.json across every theme × {ascii, powerline} (16×2=32 snapshots) under {name}__{style} suffixes so they do not collide with the golden_lines glob outputs.
Fixture cwd values point at non-existent paths, so the git subprocess fails and no git segment appears, keeping golden snapshots independent of the checkout's own git state.

injection_no_control_byte_leak renders fixtures/injection.json (cwd/model carrying ESC/BEL/CR/LF), strips only the renderer's own SGR runs, and asserts no host-supplied control byte remains, anchoring the sanitize::strip_control contract.

Snapshots live in tests/snapshots/ and are updated with 'cargo insta review' or INSTA_UPDATE=always cargo test (the Taskfile snapshots target); in CI, INSTA_UPDATE: no is set so cargo test fails rather than silently rewriting snapshots.

install.sh guards its entry point (main runs only when executed, not sourced, via the BASH_SOURCE check), so tests/install.bats sources it directly and exercises individual functions side-effect free; the networked happy path is covered by verify-install.yml.

tests/install.bats exercises detect_target (override and OS→triple mapping), release-JSON parsing (release_tag, find_asset_url), require_github_host (rejecting non-GitHub/plain-http/lookalike), verify_checksum (text/binary modes, tampered, missing entry), verify_attestation (always non-fatal), archive safety (traversal rejection), and install_from_source guards.

verify_attestation is always non-fatal by design (status 0 on every branch — gh missing, too old, unauthenticated, verification failed, or success), so a regression returning 1 cannot be masked by the SHA256 gate.

verify-install.yml runs install.sh end-to-end in a clean $HOME with cargo/rustc stripped from PATH (so a broken prebuilt download cannot be silently masked by falling through to cargo build), including piped-stdin execution matching the documented curl|bash usage.

tests/statusline.bats smoke-tests statusline-command.sh against fixtures (empty, typical, over-100% context, 5h/weekly rate-limit, effort, injection, no-git) and adds edge cases (malformed JSON, empty stdin, wrong-typed fields), skipping when jq is not installed; the injection test proves ESC bytes were stripped by checking the script never emits 16-color codes.

tests/scripts.bats syntax-checks scripts/benchmark.sh, gen-gallery.sh, and gen_terminal_gifs.sh and asserts gen-gallery.sh's fail-fast guards (missing binary, no themes parsed); benchmark.sh runtime and gen_terminal_gifs.sh runtime are intentionally not exercised there.

tests/demo_repos.bats asserts the deterministic git-state contract produced by scripts/make_demo_repos.sh (per-repo branch, ahead/behind, modified/untracked tallies), running the idempotent script once in setup_file and asserting states hold on re-run.

rust.yml (Ubuntu, stable, mold) enforces with --locked: cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings for both --all-features and --no-default-features (render-only), and cargo test for both feature configurations.

The tui feature gates ratatui/crossterm/ansi-to-tui (and the whole src/tui/ module in src/lib.rs); a --no-default-features build is render-only, verified by the clippy and cargo test runs with --no-default-features in CI.

CI runs cargo llvm-cov (--all-features) to produce lcov.info and an HTML report, posts per-PR coverage annotations via covrs; the baseline is ~74% and PRs must not regress the total by more than 1 percentage point without a note.

security.yml adds ShellCheck, actionlint, the bats suite, semgrep (trailofbits rules over shell scripts), cargo audit, gitleaks, and zizmor; benchmark.yml runs the performance SLO via scripts/benchmark.sh and uploads a report artifact.

git_unavailable_returns_false in src/segment/git.rs mocks an empty PATH via raw env mutation (restoring it afterward) and asserts Git.render returns false — the safe, no-panic fallback when the git subprocess cannot spawn — complementing the parse-status unit tests that never invoke a subprocess.

save_clears_dirty verifies that App::save writes the config to save_path and only clears the dirty flag (synchronizes saved_config) after a successful write, while reset_restores_defaults_and_cursors verifies that App::reset restores Config::default(), rebuilds the list, and clears dirty.

src/segment/mod.rs's every_kind_resolves_and_renders_empty_input walks SegmentKind::ALL and requires every variant resolve via as_segment() and render against InputData::default() without panicking, so a new segment that is never wired up or that panics on missing data fails the suite.

src/tui/app.rs's every_segment_kind_has_help_text walks SegmentKind::ALL and asserts each variant has a non-empty segment_help(kind) line that names the segment, so a new variant cannot ship an empty description in the TUI configurator.

render_golden.rs's golden_dots_style renders fixtures/typical.json with the default theme and the 'dots' style as one explicit snapshot (tests/snapshots/render_golden__golden_dots_style.snap), covering the style that neither golden_lines (default style) nor golden_matrix (ascii/powerline) exercises.

verify-install.yml runs install.sh both via 'cat install.sh | bash' piped stdin (matching the documented curl|bash usage and catching unbound-variable bugs that only surface without a source file) and via a normal 'bash install.sh' invocation, in each case under a clean $HOME with cargo stripped from PATH, then asserts $HOME/.claude/claudebar exists and runs --version and 'echo {} | claudebar render' when the runner arch can execute the binary.
